subject: general
question: Which Indian airport secured a position among the top 10 hub airports in the AsiaPacific and Middle East region in the 2024 ACI Hub Connectivity Rankings?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indira Gandhi International Airport (IGIA)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indira Gandhi International Airport (IGIA)** is located in **New Delhi, India**, and is one of the busiest and most significant airports in the country.
 
• In the **2024 ACI Hub Connectivity Rankings**, IGIA was recognized as one of the **top 10 hub airports** in the **Asia-Pacific and Middle East region**.
 
• This achievement highlights the airport’s **role as a major global connectivity hub** and its ability to facilitate extensive passenger and cargo traffic.
 
• The **ACI Hub Connectivity Rankings** measure the ability of airports to connect passengers efficiently with other destinations worldwide, making this recognition a significant accomplishment for IGIA.
 
• The airport's inclusion in this ranking demonstrates its **commitment to operational excellence**, **modern infrastructure**, and a **high standard of passenger experience**.
 
• The recognition also reflects India's growing prominence in the global aviation sector and the strategic importance of IGIA in connecting India with the rest of the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Indira Gandhi International Airport (IGIA):**

 
 
• Located in **New Delhi**, IGIA is named after **Indira Gandhi**, the former Prime Minister of India.
 
• It is operated by **Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL)**, a consortium led by GMR Group in partnership with the Airports Authority of India.
 
• The airport has a **world-class Terminal 3**, which caters to international flights and is equipped with modern facilities to handle millions of passengers annually.
 
 
 
• **ACI Hub Connectivity Rankings:**
 
 
• These rankings are released by the **Airports Council International (ACI)**, a global trade representative of the world’s airport authorities.
 
• The rankings evaluate airports based on their ability to connect passengers to various destinations, emphasizing **hubs with high connectivity**.
 
• The rankings underline the airport's role in facilitating **efficient passenger and cargo movement** globally.
 
 
 
• **India's Aviation Growth:**
 
 
• India is one of the fastest-growing aviation markets in the world, with airports like IGIA playing a pivotal role in enhancing global connectivity.
 
• The recognition of IGIA highlights India's increasing importance in the global aviation industry.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Indian Airports:**

 
 
• **Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport** in Mumbai is another key airport in India, known for its significant contribution to passenger and cargo traffic.
 
• **Kempegowda International Airport** in Bengaluru is recognized for its modern infrastructure and efficient operations.
 
• **Chennai International Airport** serves as a vital gateway to South India and handles a substantial volume of domestic and international passengers.
 
 
 
• **Global Significance of IGIA:**
 
 
• IGIA’s inclusion in the top 10 hub airports highlights India's capability to provide world-class aviation facilities.
 
• It underscores the importance of New Delhi as a **key global transit point** for passengers and cargo.
